title: Pathways-supported career conversation
partner: Pathways partner network — partner confirmation required
eligibility: Pathways students; age and partner eligibility must be confirmed
description: An introductory conversation with a healthcare or health-sciences professional. A practical starting point while clinical shadowing eligibility and site requirements are being confirmed.
requirements_summary: Pathways coordinator will confirm age eligibility, partner approval, scheduling, and any school or guardian permissions.

title: Healthcare workplace or department tour
partner: Pathways partner network — partner confirmation required
eligibility: Pathways students; age and partner eligibility must be confirmed
description: A guided introduction to a healthcare workplace or approved non-clinical department. The host determines permitted spaces and visitor rules.
requirements_summary: Coordinator verifies host permission, age rules, guardian/school requirements, visitor registration, supervision, and safety instructions.

title: Simulation, skills lab, or research environment observation
partner: Pathways partner network — partner confirmation required
eligibility: Pathways students; age and host eligibility must be confirmed
description: Observe a skills demonstration, simulation session, or approved research environment without participating in clinical care or restricted activities.
requirements_summary: Host must approve student age, lab/simulation access, supervision, PPE or safety training, and visitor registration.
